errors.evidence: For the 'Внос' (Import) chart, the 'ЕС' (EU) line shows a clear declining trend from its peak of ~29% in 2012 down to ~23% in 2019. Describing this as 'stabilized' is an over-generalization.
For the 'Износ' (Export) chart, the 'Общо' (Total) line reaches its peak of approximately 39% in 2013, not 35%.
For the 'Износ' (Export) chart, the 'ЕС' (EU) line reaches its maximum value of approximately 30% in the year 2010, not 28% in 2012.
For the 'Износ' (Export) chart, the 'Извън ЕС' (Non-EU) line reaches its peak of approximately 52% around 2012-2013, not 55%.
For the 'Износ' (Export) chart, the 'Извън ЕС' (Non-EU) line ends at approximately 40% in 2019, not 35%.
